summary: Compensation enhancement in motor accident claim; multiplier error corrected from 17 to 18 under Sarla Verma; 40% future prospects included per Pranay Sethi; revised loss of future earnings; total compensation increased to Rs.3,83,920 with interest; cost of Rs.50,000 imposed on respondent for non-appearance.
legal_provisions_cited: Sarla Verma v Delhi Transport Corporation, 2009 (6) SCC 121
National Insurance Company Limited v Pranay Sethi, 2017 (16) SCC 680
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Impugned Judgment modified; compensation enhanced to Rs.3,83,920 with interest; cost of Rs.50,000 imposed on respondent.
